blocks.html: Untreated rainwater collected for reuse shall be filtered as required for the intended nonpotable end use as established by the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene. Filters shall be accessible for inspection and maintenance. Filters shall utilize a pressure gauge or other approved method to provide indication when a filter requires servicing or replacement. Filters shall be installed with shutoff valves installed immediately upstream and downstream to allow for isolation during maintenance.
